dialogue.origin: こんばんわ相談員です。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.content: Good evening, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Good evening. It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどんなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 自分の時間の使い方や
dialogue.content: It's about how I use my time, and...

dialogue.origin: 人間関係？です…
dialogue.content: my relationships with people? I guess...

dialogue.origin: はい、お越しいただき有難うございます。具体的に教えて頂いてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see, thank you for coming in. Could you tell me more about it in detail?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 以前は大丈夫でしたが、コロナで
dialogue.content: I was fine before, but because of COVID...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 在宅勤務になってから、家に居ても
dialogue.content: since I started working from home, even when I'm at home...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 落ち着かないような、ホッとしないような感じです
dialogue.content: I feel restless, like I can't really relax.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、そんなかんかくなのですね
dialogue.content: I see—that's how it feels for you.

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 今までは、通勤することで
dialogue.content: Before, by commuting...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: 生活にメリハリがあったのかなと思います…
dialogue.content: I think it gave my life some structure and contrast.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、ですね
dialogue.content: I see... that makes sense.

dialogue.origin: 以前は、ご自宅ではどんなかんかくだったのですか？
dialogue.content: How did being at home feel for you before?

dialogue.origin: 自宅では、ぼーっと過ごしていました
dialogue.content: At home, I used to just zone out.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、ご自宅でノンビリできてたのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you were able to relax and take it easy at home.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 私、たぶんマイペース型です
dialogue.content: I think I'm the type who goes at my own pace.

dialogue.origin: 今は、ぼーっとできない感じですか？
dialogue.content: And now it feels like you can't zone out?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: はい、マイペース、いいじゃないですか！
dialogue.content: Yes, going at your own pace is great!

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。嬉しいです！
dialogue.content: Thank you. That makes me happy!

dialogue.origin: ご自分の人生ですから、マイペースで良いと思います
dialogue.content: It's your life, so I think it's perfectly fine to go at your own pace.

dialogue.origin: はい（笑）
dialogue.content: Yes (laughs).

dialogue.origin: コロナから、少しご自宅での感覚が変わってきたのですね？
dialogue.content: So, since COVID started, the way you feel at home has changed a bit, is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: それは、、
dialogue.content: And is that...

dialogue.origin: 何かげんいんというか、気になることとかございますか？
dialogue.content: ...any particular reason for that, or something that's been bothering you?

dialogue.origin: 心当たりが…あります
dialogue.content: I think... I have an idea what it might be.

dialogue.origin: 最近、苦痛になったのがLINEの対応です…
dialogue.content: Lately, dealing with LINE messages has become stressful...

dialogue.origin: あと、長電話です
dialogue.content: And long phone calls, too.

dialogue.origin: はい・・・ぃねですか
dialogue.content: I see—LINE, is it?

dialogue.origin: Lineと、長電話でしか・・・
dialogue.content: So it's LINE and the long phone calls...

dialogue.origin: それは、どなたとですか？
dialogue.content: Who are those with?

dialogue.origin: 職場の同僚です
dialogue.content: With my colleagues from work.

dialogue.origin: LINEは友人と同僚です…
dialogue.content: LINE is with friends and colleagues...

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、お仕事のやり取りの電話と、
dialogue.content: I see. So, phone calls for work conversations, and...

dialogue.origin: ご友人とのLineも違和感ある感じですか？
dialogue.content: do you also feel uneasy about the LINE messages with your friends?

dialogue.origin: もう少し具体的に、どんな状況、どんな感じか教えて頂いてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me a little more specifically about the situation and how it makes you feel?

dialogue.origin: 一日中、ずっと仕事とLINEや電話をしているような感じで
dialogue.content: It feels like I'm constantly dealing with work, LINE, or phone calls all day long.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、お忙しいわけですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you're quite busy then.

dialogue.origin: 職場にいた時の方が気楽でした
dialogue.content: I felt more at ease when I was at the office.

dialogue.origin: 同じ部屋というか、同じ空間にいるのでホッとしなくなった感覚です
dialogue.content: Since I'm in the same room, or the same space, all the time, I feel like I can't relax.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、出社してるころとの大きな違いですね
dialogue.content: I see, that's a big difference from when you were commuting to the office.

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: なぜ、そうなってしまったのでしょうね？
dialogue.content: I wonder why it's become that way.

dialogue.origin: お相手は変わらないわけですよね？
dialogue.content: The people you're interacting with haven't changed, right?

dialogue.origin: 在宅なので、日中は自分の判断で仕事を進めますが、雑談程度はいつもの事ですが
dialogue.content: Since I'm working from home, I proceed with work based on my own judgment during the day, and a bit of small talk is normal, but...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: 出社の時と、在宅勤務では、何が大きく変わってきてますか？
dialogue.content: What has changed the most between when you went to the office and now working from home?

dialogue.origin: 仕事と私生活のたてわけでしょうか
dialogue.content: The separation between my work and private life, I suppose.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、確かにキッチリ分けるのは難しそうですね
dialogue.content: I see. It certainly does seem difficult to separate them completely.

dialogue.origin: ご相談者様は、何か工夫とかされましたでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Have you tried doing anything to help with that?

dialogue.origin: 観葉植物を置いたり、室内の模様替えをしたりしたのですが
dialogue.content: I tried putting out some houseplants and rearranging my room, but...

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、いいですね！
dialogue.content: I see, that's a great idea!

dialogue.origin: はい、でいかがですか？
dialogue.content: And how did that feel?

dialogue.origin: ホッとはしないですね…
dialogue.content: I still don't feel relaxed...

dialogue.origin: リモート飲み会も
dialogue.content: The remote drinking parties too...

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、お辛いですね
dialogue.content: I see, that must be difficult.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: リモート飲みですか
dialogue.content: Remote drinking parties?

dialogue.origin: いかがですか？
dialogue.content: How has that been?

dialogue.origin: 会社から禁止が出たので、リモート飲み会はなくなりましたが
dialogue.content: The company banned them, so we don't have remote drinking parties anymore, but...

dialogue.origin: えっ、そうなんですかーそれは残念な感じですか？
dialogue.content: Oh, really? Do you feel disappointed about that?

dialogue.origin: とくに残念な気持ちはないです
dialogue.content: Not particularly.

dialogue.origin: 友人や同僚も、長期の在宅勤務で疲れてるのかもしれないです…
dialogue.content: My friends and colleagues might also be tired from working from home for so long...

dialogue.origin: 電話を切るタイミングがよくわからなくて
dialogue.content: I just don't know when the right time to end a phone call is.

dialogue.origin: なるほど・・・
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: みなさん、疲れてらっしゃいますよね
dialogue.content: Everyone is tired, aren't they.

dialogue.origin: ご相談者様はどうなればベストと思われますか？
dialogue.content: What would be the best outcome for you?

dialogue.origin: 早く日常が戻れば、みんなイライラしないのに…と
dialogue.content: I just think if things would go back to normal sooner, everyone wouldn't be so irritable...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, that's true.

dialogue.origin: 他には、、何か思われることございますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else that comes to mind?

dialogue.origin: そう思っていたら、私がこちらにご相談をしているような状況です
dialogue.content: Thinking that way is what led me to seek consultation here.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、ご相談頂いて有難うございます
dialogue.content: I understand. Thank you for reaching out.

dialogue.origin: 先ほど、、通勤のことお話し頂いてましたが、
dialogue.content: Earlier, you mentioned commuting,

dialogue.origin: 通勤されると、イライラ感はございませんでしたか？
dialogue.content: When you were commuting, did you feel irritable then?

dialogue.origin: 通勤は自分のチャンネル切り替えだと思っていました
dialogue.content: I thought of my commute as a way to switch gears for myself.

dialogue.origin: 夏場の暑い時はイライラもありますけれど
dialogue.content: Though I do get irritated in the summer heat.

dialogue.origin: なるほどですね、、
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 仕事とプライベートの、切り替えになってたわけですね
dialogue.content: So it served as a switch between your work and private life.

dialogue.origin: 私はマイペースで、日頃から話しを聴く側でした
dialogue.content: I go at my own pace, and I've always been the listener in conversations.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: いまはどんな感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: And how is it for you now?

dialogue.origin: ランチしながら話しを聴いたりしていましたが、今は時間制限無しのような感じです
dialogue.content: I used to listen to people talk over lunch, but now it feels like there's no time limit.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、そういう違和感も感じてらっしゃったわけですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you were feeling a sense of unease about that as well.

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 全体的に時間に区切りがなくなった感じなのですね
dialogue.content: So overall, it feels like there are no clear boundaries in your time anymore.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そういう感覚です
dialogue.content: That's how it feels.

dialogue.origin: 確かに、それはキリがない感じでお辛いですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, that must be difficult, feeling like it's endless.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、よくわかりました。
dialogue.content: I see. I understand that very well.

dialogue.origin: 疲れが抜けないのです
dialogue.content: I can't shake the fatigue.

dialogue.origin: ぼーっと出来ないので…
dialogue.content: Because I can't zone out...

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、疲れが溜まりそうですね
dialogue.content: I see, it sounds like the fatigue would really build up.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、いつも緊張感が抜けない感じでしょうね
dialogue.content: Right, it must feel like the tension never lets up.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 緊張が抜けない感じです
dialogue.content: It feels like I can't release the tension.

dialogue.origin: 疲れが溜まってらいっしゃるようですが、体調への変化や、睡眠時間などはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: It sounds like you're quite exhausted. Have you noticed any changes in your physical condition or your sleep time?

dialogue.origin: 朝、起きるのが辛くなりました…在宅のせいかもしれないですけど…
dialogue.content: It's become hard to get up in the morning... Maybe because of working from home...

dialogue.origin: 入浴で携帯から離れたりしています
dialogue.content: I try to get away from my phone by taking a bath.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、携帯から縛られる感じもあったんもですね、、それはまた苦しい感覚でしたね
dialogue.content: I see, so you felt tied down by your phone as well. That must have been another distressing feeling.

dialogue.origin: はい…
dialogue.content: Yes...

dialogue.origin: 朝お辛いのですね・・・
dialogue.content: Mornings are hard for you...

dialogue.origin: フゥ〜ッ
dialogue.content: (Sighs)

dialogue.origin: っと思ってしまいます
dialogue.content: That's what I end up thinking.

dialogue.origin: 何か解決できる方法とか、緩和できることとかあるといいですね
dialogue.content: It would be good if there were some way to resolve this, or something to alleviate it.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、、
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: お疲れ様です。。
dialogue.content: This must be very tiring for you.

dialogue.origin: お友達とかで、何か上手く対処されてる方法とかお聞きになったことございますか？
dialogue.content: Have you heard from any of your friends about ways they're coping with this successfully?

dialogue.origin: 聞いた事はないです
dialogue.content: I haven't.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 普段は何か、ストレス軽減とか、
dialogue.content: Do you normally do anything for stress relief, or...

dialogue.origin: 切り替えなる何かとか、あったりされますか？
dialogue.content: something to help you switch gears?

dialogue.origin: 入浴しながら読書したり
dialogue.content: I read while taking a bath,

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: いいですね！
dialogue.content: That's great!

dialogue.origin: インドア系なので、映画鑑賞をしたり
dialogue.content: and since I'm an indoors person, I watch movies.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 電話を切るタイミングが掴めれば、今よりラクだなぁと…
dialogue.content: If I could just figure out the right time to end a phone call, I think I'd feel more at ease...

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、それはいい発想ですね！
dialogue.content: I see. That's a good idea!

dialogue.origin: 話しを聴いてしまうところを変えるしかないかと…
dialogue.content: I guess I have no choice but to change the part of me that just keeps listening...

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、そんな時、ぶっちゃけて、手にかけてる仕事あるので、また後で電話する、、とかキリをつけることはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Out of curiosity, in those moments, how about being blunt and saying something like, "I have some work to do right now, so I'll call you back later," to set a boundary?

dialogue.origin: 同僚なので、仕事を理解したうえでの電話なのです…
dialogue.content: They're my colleagues, so they call me understanding that I'm working...

dialogue.origin: はい、失礼しました。
dialogue.content: Ah, my apologies.

dialogue.origin: そうしますと、その電話の内容もお仕事、、
dialogue.content: In that case, is the content of the call also about work...?

dialogue.origin: 家族と息が詰まって電話してきています
dialogue.content: They're calling because they feel suffocated with their family.

dialogue.origin: そういう同僚さんもいらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.content: I see, so you have colleagues like that.

dialogue.origin: 家族持ちの同僚は、室内にテント？のようなものをはって仕事しています（笑）
dialogue.content: My colleague who has a family works inside something like a tent set up in their room (laughs).

dialogue.origin: そうですか、、そんな工夫もあるのですね
dialogue.content: Is that so—there are such creative solutions.

dialogue.origin: 相談者様は何か他にも工夫できそうですか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else you think you could try?

dialogue.origin: リモートにお子さんが参加してしまいからとの事です
dialogue.content: They said it's because their child ends up joining the remote meetings.

dialogue.origin: やはり、
dialogue.content: After all,

dialogue.origin: 携帯から離れる工夫をします
dialogue.content: I'll try to find ways to step away from my phone.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、主要因は携帯にありそうなわけですね
dialogue.content: I see. So it seems the main cause might be your phone.

dialogue.origin: ランニングをするタイプではないのですが、ランニングも一つの口実になりそうな気がしてきました
dialogue.content: I'm not the type to go running, but I'm starting to think that running could be a good excuse.

dialogue.origin: いいですねー
dialogue.content: That's a great idea.

dialogue.origin: 携帯ですと、充電も口実になるかと
dialogue.content: With your phone, you could also use charging it as an excuse.

dialogue.origin: あと、キャッチホンもあります
dialogue.content: And there's call waiting, too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです！
dialogue.content: Exactly!

dialogue.origin: ですが、充電しながら通話
dialogue.content: But they talk while it's charging.

dialogue.origin: はい、でも通話に充電が間に合わないこともあります
dialogue.content: True, but sometimes the charging can't keep up with the call.

dialogue.origin: Lineしてて充電がなくなったところで、電話してたら、充電しても間に合わないと思います
dialogue.content: If you were on LINE and the battery died, and then you got a call, I don't think charging it would be fast enough.

dialogue.origin: それが間に合っているのです
dialogue.content: It actually does keep up.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、、口実としてのアイディアでしたが・・・
dialogue.content: I see—it was just an idea for an excuse...

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます！
dialogue.content: Thank you!

dialogue.origin: であれば、やはり、例えばぶっちゃけて、今から集中させて！とお願いされるとか、、
dialogue.content: In that case, then perhaps you could try being blunt and asking, 'Please let me focus right now.'

dialogue.origin: お友達だしたら言えると思いますが、仕事関係の方には難しいですかね？
dialogue.content: I think you could say that to a friend, but is it difficult with people from work?

dialogue.origin: 自分を守るのは自分しかいないですので、おっしゃる通りだと思います！
dialogue.content: I'm the only one who can protect myself, so I think you're absolutely right!

dialogue.origin: はい、、おっしゃるとおり私も思います
dialogue.content: Yes, I think you're absolutely right.

dialogue.origin: あるいは、彼女にこちらの窓口へのご相談を進めてみます
dialogue.content: Alternatively, I'll try suggesting to her that she consult with a service like this.

dialogue.origin: 自分の事は自分で守る！
dialogue.content: Protect yourself!

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Yes!

dialogue.origin: はい、、彼女さんですね
dialogue.content: Yes, your colleague.

dialogue.origin: わかりました、お勧めお願いします
dialogue.content: Understood—please feel free to recommend us.

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Okay!

dialogue.origin: 笑！
dialogue.content: (laughs)

dialogue.origin: ここまでお話し頂いていかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How do you feel after talking about all of this?

dialogue.origin: お話しを聴いていただけて、自分の対策が
dialogue.content: Having you listen to me has helped me see

dialogue.origin: 見えてきたように思います
dialogue.content: what steps I can take for myself.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます！
dialogue.content: Thank you very much!

dialogue.origin: それは良かったです
dialogue.content: I'm glad to hear that.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、本日はお越しいただき有難うございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well for coming in today.

dialogue.origin: また、何かありましたら、ご相談をさせていただきます
dialogue.content: If something else comes up, I'll come back for another session.

dialogue.origin: ぜひ、ご自分を守りながら、工夫されてみてください。
dialogue.content: Please do try to protect your own boundaries as you experiment with strategies.

dialogue.origin: はい、また宜しくお願いします
dialogue.content: Yes, I look forward to speaking again.

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: Yes!

dialogue.origin: 本日は以上で宜しかったでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Shall we wrap up here for today?

dialogue.origin: 今日は、ありがとうございました！
dialogue.content: Thank you for everything today!

dialogue.origin: 本日は有難うございました！
dialogue.content: Thank you for your time today!

dialogue.origin: お疲れ様でした！
dialogue.content: Take care.

dialogue.origin: これで失礼いたします
dialogue.content: I'll sign off now.

dialogue.origin: お疲れさまでした
dialogue.content: Thank you. Take care.

topic.sub: 在宅勤務によるコミュニケーションの難しさ
